Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The Bangladesh players are out there in the middle. Brandon King and Kyle Mayers are the openers for the West Indies. Nasum Ahmed to start with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, a decent total on the board. However, it is just a par one and West Indies are still the favourites to win this one. Can the Bangla bowlers make a match out of it? Stay tuned for the run-chase!

Jamie Siddons, the batting coach of Bangladesh, says that they tried not to play too many shots in the air. On Shakib's aggressive intent, Siddons replies that it was not a role given to him but he has played enough T20 cricket and probably sensed an opportunity. The batting coach is happy that the other batters consolidated. Mentions that he is pleased with the way Afif Hossain batted, extending his good form from the last match. Feels that the pitch is offering grip as the West Indian bowlers were relying on the slower ones.

The Windies bowlers were good in patches and Pooran would have expected a better performance from his bowlers. The spinners got some help from the pitch and bowled well with Hayden Walsh leading the way with a 2-fer. However, there were plenty of loose deliveries in between and that allowed the Bangladesh batters to score at a decent rate. Obed McCoy did not get any wickets but he bowled well at the death and a special mention to Odean Smith who was quite good on the field and took a brilliant catch to dismiss Shakib Al Hasan.

One of the perennial problems for Bangladesh cricket has been the failure of their top order with the bat. They lost two wickets in the Powerplay today as well and it included a big wicket of Shakib Al Hasan. However, Litton Das who has not lived up to his billing in this series started building a nice partnership with Afif Hossain. Litton Das departed after a fine knock in the 13th over, falling just short of his fifty. Afif Hossain though continued and went on to get his half century. Bangladesh would have liked a better finish here and that is one area other than the Powerplay batting that they need to work on. The Bangladesh bowlers have a decent amount of runs in their kitty now and they need to start well with the ball here to level the series.

A competitive total on the board from Bangladesh! However, West Indies would be quietly happy with their performance here, especially at the death. The pitch has some turn in it but it is still a very good wicket to bat and with the kind of firepower West Indies have in their tank, they would fancy chasing this total down.
Slower bouncer around middle, Mosaddek Hossain tries to pull but misses. They steal a bye as Nicholas Pooran misses his shy at the striker's end. 12 from the over, Bangladesh end on 163 for 5.
FOUR! Fine shot! Slower one, full and on middle, Mosaddek Hossain picks it and hammers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.

FOUR! Back of a length, around leg, it's whipped down to deep backward square leg. Hayden Walsh moves across to his right and slides to push the ball back in play. The umpire goes upstairs to check and the replays find that Walsh was in contact with the rope and ball at the same time.
A dipping full toss around off, slower one again, Nurul pushes it to mid off for just a run.
Shortish and around leg, Mosaddek Hossain helps it on one bounce to short fine leg and scampers across to the other end.
Obed McCoy bowls it on a length and outside off, just inside the tram line. Mosaddek Hossain steps back and then leaves. He is shocked that it's not given as a wide.
Wide! Slower one, short but down the leg side, Mosaddek turns inside the crease and then leaves.
Goes back and punches it down to long on for a single. Top over from Walsh!
Mosaddek Hossain is the next man in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Quicker one, full and around off, Afif clips it through mid-wicket and picks up a single to complete his fifty. He though wants to return on strike and scampers back for the second run. The throw from Rovman Powell comes to the keeper and Pooran is quick to dislodge the bails. They appeal and it is referred upstairs. Hossain is found way short in the replays. Two set batters fall in quick succession and it's a body blow to Bangladesh.

Is this a run out? Afif Hossain looks in trouble here. This is a good throw from the deep at the batter's end. Afif Hossain puts in a desperate dive to make his ground but he is short here and has to walk back.
Mishit! Loopy and full outside off, Nurul lofts it without much timing over mid off. They cross.
Nurul Hasan is the next man in.

OUT! GIVEN LBW! Hayden Walsh serves a full ball around middle and it straightens a touch after landing. Mahmudullah attempts to play the reverse-batted shot but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal and the finger goes up after a while. Mahmudullah takes the DRS. Nothing on the UltraEdge and the Ball Trackings shows three reds. Everything is adjacent and the Bangla skipper returns dejected.
Short and outside off, Mahmudullah tries to cut but misses.

FOUR! The sweeper on the off side fails to pick it. Short in length and outside off, Mahmudullah goes on the back foot and smacks it to the sweeper cover fence. Rovman Powell is the culprit. Nicholas Pooran is heard saying - 'You're sleeping over there!'
Interesting choice by Pooran as he brings on Hayden Walsh to bowl the 19th over.
Swing and a miss! Obed McCoy nails the slower one this time. Short and wide outside off, at 112 kph, Afif Hossain flashes his bat at it but fails to connect.
Full toss outside off, forced down to long off for a single.
Slower one, short and down the leg side, Mahmudullah is way too early into his shot and it takes his gloves before rolling behind.
FOUR! Mahmudullah makes the bowler pay. Fuller in length and outside off, the Bangla skipper drills his drive through covers for a boundary.
NO BALL! Obed McCoy tries to bowl it from back of his hand but loses the radar completely. He sprays it outside the pitch, towards the off side and will have to rebowl. Free Hit coming up...
Off pace delivery, short and wide outside off, Afif is early into the shot and pushes it off the toe end of his bat to long off. Only a run again.
Fuller in length, around leg, Mahmudullah works it through mid-wicket and takes a single.
Obed McCoy is back on.
Flatter one, short and on middle, Mahmudullah goes back and turns it through square leg for a single. A fine over by Akeal.
Fuller and on off, Afif helps it in front of square leg for a quick run.
Wide! Spinning down the leg side, Afif Hossain leaves.
Short and outside off, cut towards point for one.
NOT OUT! Quicker one, around leg, Afif clips it to short fine leg and they attempt for a quick run. There is a direct hit at the striker's end and they appeal. The replays find Mahmudullah safely in.
Is that a run-out? It is a direct hit from Odean Smith at the batter's end but the replays show that Mahmudullah has his bat inside the crease.
Turning down the leg side, Afif gets across and tries to flick but misses.
Follows the batter down the leg side and fires it flat and short, Afif Hossain tickles it to mid-wicket and scampers back for the second run.
Akeal Hosein comes back to bowl his last over. Three overs for 24 so far.

Slower one, full and around off, Afif drags his attempted heave shot just over the bowler's head. Rovman Powell attacks the ball from long on and the batters decide not to risk the second run. 16 from the over.
FOUR! Smashed! Afif Hossain is again showing his hitting prowess. Romario Shepherd aims for the yorker but it turns out to be a full toss outside off, Afif whacks it over extra cover.
SIX! Nailed! Fuller in length, around middle, Afif Hossain finds it in the slot and launches it handsomely over long on for a biggie.
Yorker outside off, Afif Hossain tries to dig it out but misses.
Tucks a length ball through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and around off, Afif heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a couple. There is a direct hit at the striker's end, the ball deflects away from the keeper and they pick another run.
Wide! Fuller in length and way wide outside off, Afif Hossain tries to reach out but misses.
Quicker and fuller outside off, Afif Hossain plays a lofted drive to long off for a single.
Flighted around leg, Afif Hossain again attempts to reverse-sweep but it takes the toe end of his bat. Nicholas Pooran sticks his right leg out and makes the stop.
A bit unorthodox from Afif Hossain. This is tossed up on the middle, Afif plays the reverse-sweep towards the deep backward point region for a couple.
Shorter in length and outside off, Mahmudullah cuts it to point for a single.
This is slower on off, Mahmudullah punches it to covers.

SIX! Just over the fielder in the deep and over the ropes this time! Walsh delivers a half-tracker on middle. Mahmudullah rocks back and pulls it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. Romario Shepherd there jumps to catch it but the ball goes just over him and over the ropes for a maximum.
Short and outside off, Afif Hossain uses the pace of the delivery and guides it wide of third man for a brace.
On a length and on leg, Mahmudullah tucks it to square leg for a run.
Bowls a full toss on off, Mahmudullah drives it to mid off.
Obed McCoy bowls almost a yorker-length delivery, outside off at 130 kph. Mahmudullah opens the face of his blade and guides it towards backward point.
Goes full again, on middle this time. Mahmudullah only manages to clip it towards the short mid-wicket fielder.
This is full on off. Mahmudullah drives it straight to the mid off fielder.
Obed McCoy is back on.
Quicker and onto the stumps, Mahmudullah tries to defend it off his back foot but it takes an inside edge and goes towards fine leg. The batters cross. 100 up!
Skipper Mahmudullah walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Litton Das departs and Walsh strikes and gets a big wicket here! This is a lovely delivery, flighted outside off. Das makes a bit of room as he skips down the track looking to loft it over extra-cover. However, he only gets a thick outside edge and Akeal Hosein, at backward point, takes a fine catch. Das departs after playing a handy knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Full and down the leg side, Afif mistimes his sweep and the ball goes to short fine leg. They cross.
A bit short on the leg stump line, Afif makes room and punches it straight to the extra cover fielder.
This is fuller on middle. Das skips down the track and drives it to long on for a single.
A full toss on middle. Afif Hossain sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a single.
In the channel outside off, dabbed down to third man for a run. 20 from the over!
SIX! Superb timing! This one is full and on middle, Afif Hossain just heaves it over long on for another maximum in this over.
On a length and on middle, Das pushes this on the leg side for a single.
Wide! Smith tries the yorker, but it goes down the leg side. Litton Das tries to play at it but misses. It's called a wide.
SIX! Beautiful Shot! Odean Smith bowls it full and outside off, Litton Das holds his position and just lofts it over the deep extra cover fence for a maximum.
WIDE! Short and wide outside off. Das looks to get a bat on it but misses.
FOUR! Boundary this time! It is shorter in length, around leg. Das pulls it this time and gets enough bat as the ball runs away towards the fine leg fence.

Run out chance! Odean Smith hurls in a length ball around leg, Litton Das walks down the track for a big heave over the leg side but misses. It beats the stumps and goes behind to the keeper. Nicholas Pooran doesn't collect it cleanly and Das thinks that there is a run. He steps out but Afif Hossain sends him back in time as Pooran misses his shy.
Slower through the air on leg, Litton Das flicks it to square leg for a run.

In the air...but the ball falls in the vacant region just away from Walsh! This is a googly on middle. Afif Hossain goes for a big slog across the line. He, however, gets a huge top edge and the ball goes in the air towards the mid on region. Walsh goes running behind it and looks set to catch it but makes a slight glance at the fielder coming in from long on. That moment puts Hayden off and the ball drops away from him. The batters take a run.
Floated and on middle, Afif Hossain comes down the track but gets hit on his pads.
Walsh with a flatter delivery on middle, Afif Hossain, who backs away again, punches it to the cover fielder in the ring.
This is full and outside off. Das drives and drives it uppishly but well short of the sweeper cover fielder for a single.
Pushed quicker on middle, Afif Hossain makes room and late-cuts it square of the wicket towards the off side for a single.
Hayden Walsh to bowl his leggies after the halfway mark.
Swing and a miss! This is full and outside off, angling in a bit, Litton Das throws his bat but could not connect.
Lands it short and on middle, Afif tries to flick it but it goes off his gloves towards square leg. They cross.
Bowls it full and outside off, Litton Das punches this to deep point for a single.

Great attempt by Akeal Hosein, at point, but the ball goes just past him. It is short and outside off, Afif Hossain cuts it firmly but uppishly and Akeal Hosein dives to his right. However, the ball goes just over and past him and a single is taken.
Short ball on off. Das looks to pull it but misses. The ball hits his shoulder and runs away towards third man. A leg bye is taken.

On the shorter side, around off at 135 kph. Afif Hossain just steers it towards third man for a single. The throw is wayward and the batters think of another run for a second but eventually settle for a single.
Odean Smith comes back into the attack. 1 for 10 in his 1 over so far.
Floated on off, Das blocks it down the pitch. Expensive over from Akeal Hosein, 13 from it.
Short and outside off, Das makes room and cuts it past point for a single. The fielder fumbles slightly and they take the second run.
SIX! First maximum of the innings. Tossed up on off, Das goes on one knee and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
This is tossed up on middle, Das works it towards mid-wicket.
On the shorter side again angling into leg. Afif Hossain makes room and slaps it to long on for a single.

FOUR! Ohh...just short of the fielder in the deep and it runs away for a boundary! Afif Hossain makes room early and Akeal Hosein follows him. It is shorter in length and Afif Hossain pulls it aerially towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder in the deep, Rovman Powell, comes charging in and dives forward to attempt for the catch. However, the ball falls short and goes past him for a boundary.
Back of a length on middle, Das pushes this to short mid-wicket. A good start from Dominic Drakes.

Lands it short on middle and leg, Das pulls it in the air to the deep backward square leg region for a brace. There were shouts of 'catch it' but it lands safely and Akeal Hossain does well to stop the boundary.
On a length and outside off, Afif Hossain cuts it towards deep point for a single.

An appeal for an LBW, but the umpire is not interested and Pooran after thinking for a while decides against taking a review. Pitches it on off and the ball comes back in with the angle. Afif Hossain looks to lift it across the line. However, he misses and gets rapped up on his pads. There is an appeal from the keeper first and then the bowler joins him. No damage is done in the end.
Lands it on a length, on middle. Afif Hossain clips it towards the deep backward square leg region and the batters come back for the second run. 50 up for Bangladesh!
Starts off with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off. Das waits for it and guides it towards third man for a single.
Dominic Drakes comes into the attack.

MISSED RUN OUT CHANCE! Flighted delivery, around middle, Afif Hossain tickles it down to fine leg and attempts for the second run. The throw comes fast and flat to the keeper who leaves it hoping for a direct hit. It misses the stumps by a whisker. The replays show that Afif Hossain would have been a goner.
Floated on off, Afif blocks it to the leg side.

Drops it short this time, held onto the pitch spinning away, Litton Das plays a casual shot and the ball lands just short of the bowler. They take a single because of the misfield from Akeal who deflects it past the cover fielder.

Beautifully bowled! This is nicely tossed up on off. It lands and grips. Das pushes forward to defend but the ball beats the outside edge of his blade. Already signs of help for the spinners here, interesting!

Hosein goes shorter this time and angles it down the leg side. Afif Hossain looks to pull it but misses. Pooran fails to collect it cleanly as well and the batters take a bye as the ball rolls towards the leg side off the gloves of Pooran.
Akeal Hosein pushes it flatter and quicker on middle. Afif Hossain just tucks it towards the leg side.
Change of ends for Akeal Hosein. One over for 8 runs so far.
Shepherd goes full and outside off, Das drives but finds mid off. Fine over comes to an end. At the end of the Powerplay, Bangladesh are 44 for 2.
Back of a length, around middle, glanced behind square leg for a single.
On a length and outside off, Das steers it to point and Odean Smith is in action again. He dives across to his left to make the stop. Cannot prevent the single though.
Afif Hossain is the next man in.

OUT! WHAT A CATCH! Odean Smith takes a steepler of a catch. Shakib wanted to be positive but he departs in the process. Romario Shepherd serves it on a length and around middle, at 135 kph, Shakib Al Hasan aims to heave it over mid-wicket but it goes straight up in the air off the top edge. Odean Smith, stationed inside the ring, gets underneath this swirling chance, keeps his eyes on the ball and completes the catch with a dive. Brilliant!
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Romario Shepherd

Commentary.Commentary: Short and wide outside off, Das stays back and slaps it to deep point for a single.
Shortish and around off, defended down on the pitch.
Romario Shepherd is into the attack now.
Lands it on a length around off, Das tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It deflects in front of cover-point and they cross. 10 from the over, along with a wicket.
Odean follows the batter with a short ball, Shakib does well to fend it away on the off side. It rolls in the gap and they steal a single.
FOUR! In the air but in the gap. Width outside off, on a good length, Shakib goes aerial and whacks it over point for a boundary. Opens his account in style.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out at number 3!

OUT! Anamul Haque holes out! Back of a length, around middle, Anamul tries to again power it across the line but this time the ball takes the top edge and flies to third man. Akeal Hosein moves swiftly across to his left and secures the skier safely. The opening stand is broken!
Commentary.Howout: c Akeal Hosein b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off, played down to point.
FOUR! Put away! Odean Smith begins poorly. Bowls a full toss in the line of the stumps, Anamul Haque gets across and swings it down to fine leg for a boundary.

NOT OUT! Akeal bowls it slower through the air, landing full and outside off. It lands and grips as the ball spins away. Litton tries to defend by getting forward but is beaten on the outside edge. Pooran breaks the stumps, appeals and the umpire goes upstairs. The third umpire first checks for the outside edge but it's absent as shown by the UltraEdge. The side-on angle finds Litton's back leg firmly inside the crease.

A review for a stumping chance! Litton Das is the man in question here. The replays roll in and they first check if any bat is involved or not. There is no bat involved as confirmed by the UltraEdge and neither is Litton Das out of his crease as further replays suggest.
Flatter and on off, Anamul punches it from the back foot to mid-wicket and takes one.
Floated and full, around off, Litton wrists it to mid-wicket and picks up a single.
FOUR! Fine shot! Flatter delivery, short and close to off, Litton Das jumps back inside the crease to give himself room and cracks it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Loopy and full, around off, Anamul Haque nudges it to mid-wicket and the bowler runs after it. They cross for a single.
Quicker and on middle, it's fired in, Das moves back and helps it in front of square leg for a single.
Will Obed McCoy continue? No, it is time for some spin now. Akeal Hosein comes into the attack.
Slower one, on a length and around off, Das gets squared up a bit but does well to tap it down to the right of the point fielder. They cross. Again 9 from the over!
FOUR! Here comes the first boundary of the match. Fuller in length, around middle, Litton Das picks it up off his pads and flicks it delightfully in front of square leg for a boundary.
Full toss outside off, Litton Das steps back to make room and pushes it through extra cover for a couple.
An inswinging yorker, around middle and off, Anamul Haque loses his balance while trying to dig it out but somehow keeps it away at square leg. They cross.
Movement into the batter, full and shaping in around off, Das knocks it down to long on for a single.
Shortish and around off, shaping down, Litton walks across the stumps and tries to play it on the leg side but misses.

Chance of a run out! No harm is done. A touch short in length around middle, shooting off the surface, Anamul Haque fails to work it around and it perhaps goes off the splice of his bat to covers. Litton Das shows interest in a run but is sent back as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. 9 from the over!
Shortish and around leg, Das glances it behind square leg and picks up a single.
Wide! This is turning out to be a very long over from Obed McCoy. He continues to leak extras. Another delivery down the leg side, the batter leaves.
Fraction short and around leg, this time Anamul Haque fails to work it around the corner. It goes off his pads to backward square leg and they cross for a leg bye.
Wide! McCoy is yet to get his rhythm. Back of a length and down the leg side, Anamul Haque lets it through to the keeper.
Drifting down the leg side, Litton Das tries to flick but misses. It clips his pads and goes past the keeper. The short fine leg fielder dives to make the stop and they cross for a leg bye.
Wide! Obed McCoy is struggling with his line at the moment. Sprays this one way wide outside off, Litton Das has nothing to do with it.

Confident appeal for an lbw, not out says the umpire. Full in length and around leg, Das tries to flick but misses. He wears it on his pads but the lbw appeal is not upheld. Perhaps pitching outside leg.
Bowls it on a length again but this time the line is on middle and leg, Litton Das quietly clips it in front of square leg and scampers back for the second run.
Wide! Wrong start from Obed. Slips a length ball down the leg side, Litton has an easy leave to make.
Obed McCoy will start from the other end.
Anamul Haque gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it to the off side. A decent start for both teams.
Fuller in length and outside off, Das pushes at it and edges it wide of short third man for a single.

Shout for an lbw! Not too much interest is shown by the umpire. Movement off the deck there. Landing on a length and outside off, jagging back in and striking Litton high on the pads as he fails to defend. Height factor.
Too full and way wide outside off, Anamul stretches out and squeezes it past the point fielder for three runs.
In the channel outside off, on a good length and moving in a bit, Anamul Haque covers his stumps and shoulders arms.

Misfield and Bangladesh are away! Kyle Mayers begins with a very full ball outside off, Das tries to dig it out but gets an outside edge. It rolls towards Akeal Hosein at short third man who fumbles and allows a run.

So, fasten your seatbelts folks! West Indies' players are in a huddle and they now disperse to take their respective positions. Litton Das and Anamul Haque are the openers for Bangladesh. It will be Kyle Mayers who will start with the ball for the Windies. All players now take the knee in support of the Black Lives Matter movement. A slip in position for Kyle Mayers. Here we go...

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that he likes playing at this venue and in front of the Guyana crowd. Informs that they have one change as Keemo Paul is unwell and Dominic Drakes comes in. Mentions that they feel that this is a good chance to win the series and hopes that they do well in this game.

Mahmudullah, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they want to bat first as it's a dry surface. Adds that they are aiming to put runs on the board and defend it later. Informs that they are going with three spinners with Nasum Ahmed coming in the XI, replacing Taskin Ahmed. Tells that they had a few positives in the last game, notably Shakib's batting, but also admits that the execution part was missing with the ball and they will like to get better today. Hopes to play good cricket.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Brandon King, Kyle Mayers, Shamarh Brooks, Nicholas Pooran (C) (WK), Rovman Powell, Romario Shepherd, Odean Smith, Dominic Drakes (In place of Keemo Paul), Akeal Hosein, Obed McCoy, Hayden Walsh.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Anamul Haque, Litton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mosaddek Hossain, Mahedi Hasan, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman, Nasum Ahmed (In place of Taskin Ahmed).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Mahmudullah. Bangladesh have elected to BAT first.

Odean Smith is down for a quick chat. The hard-hitting allrounder says that the last two games were kind of on-and-off and it is difficult to switch on and off as a player and admits that he has not been at his best, with the ball, in this series so far. Tells that he has done a lot of hard work and hopes to show his skills today. Mentions that the plan is to bowl full and he is quick in the air and also adds that they want to continue playing good cricket and carry the momentum from Dominica into this game.
